name: Deserted Island
text: Whenever you pass or swap the last card of a suit in your hand, gain +10 contract value.
timing: When you pass or swap cards

signature.target: your last card of a suit, passed away

archetypes: Swap Meet; splash Discard Dominance, Spade Master
decision: Which card to give in each pass or trade: a singleton that opens a void rather than your worst card.
opponent: Visible on trigger; opponents learn you just went void in a suit and can avoid leading it.
aiNote: In any pass or trade, give a singleton outside spades when you have one.
rationale: Trades count as passes, so Traders' Handshake swaps, Open Hand, and TE-C02 all feed it; a hand opens one or two voids a round this way (about +12 EV), and each void also sets up trumps and discards; it pays only for void-opening exchanges, as the brief requires.
